items.title: Trump Officials Draft Plan to Pay At-Home Parents, Using Funds for Working Ones
items.author: Coral Davenport
items.content: <article>The proposed benefit, a top policy priority for Vice President JD Vance, would apply only to married couples and tap a fund intended to provide federal child care subsidies to working parents.</article>

items.title: Trump’s Super PAC Will Spend $10 Million on Texas Senate Race
items.author: Theodore Schleifer
items.content: <article>A financial filing announcing the TV and digital ad buy is the first general election spending by MAGA Inc. The group intends to boost the Republican nominee, Ken Paxton.</article>

items.title: What the War in Iran Has Cost One Gold Star Family
items.author: Katie Rogers
items.content: <article>First Lt. Tyler James Feehan, who was 25, had been deployed to an air base in Jordan when enemy missiles and drones lit up the sky. He is among the 18 Americans who have died since the war began.</article>

items.title: Is Work Starting for Trump’s Arch? It Depends Who’s Asking.
items.author: Emily Badger
items.content: <article>The Justice Department told a court the government would only conduct archaeological excavation, a day after a Trump official announced the project was in motion.</article>

items.title: Missouri Asks Supreme Court to Allow Voting Map Benefiting Republicans
items.author: Mitch Smith and Ann E. Marimow
items.content: <article>Missouri’s Supreme Court said a map redrawn to help Republicans could not be used in November and said voters should decide on the new boundaries.</article>

items.title: Ossoff and Talarico to Share Fund-Raising Event in Hollywood
items.author: Theodore Schleifer
items.content: <article>The event with the Georgia and Texas Democrats will be hosted by Shonda Rhimes.</article>

items.title: Gallup Polls Show Democrats Outnumber Republicans Ahead of 2026 Midterm Elections
items.author: Ruth Igielnik and Caroline Soler
items.content: <article>Data from Gallup shows that Democrats and Democratic-leaning independents have their largest advantage over Republicans since 2008.</article>

items.title: Looking Back on the Summer of High MAGA in Trump's Washington
items.author: Shawn McCreesh and Alex Kent
items.content: <article>Racecars, crypto, billionaires, troops, sequins and a bloody cage fight.</article>

items.title: Former Kentucky Governor Is Arrested Amid Child Support Battle
items.author: Ishani Desai
items.content: <article>Matthew Bevin, the former Republican governor, was held in contempt for failing to abide by court orders to file financial disclosure documents, a lawyer said.</article>

items.title: In Major Leak Hunt, Pentagon Gives Polygraph Tests to Joint Staff Members
items.author: Jonathan Swan, Adam Entous, Maggie Haberman and Eric Schmitt
items.content: <article>About 50 people were tested, an unparalleled inquiry that comes in the wake of news reports about the war with Iran and the U.S. military’s diminished stocks of munitions.</article>

items.title: Judge Will Not Block Pentagon Move to Fire Stars and Stripes Journalists
items.author: Chris Cameron and Erik Wemple
items.content: <article>A judge appeared skeptical of the journalists’ arguments that they were fired for coverage of worsening conditions on a Navy warship.</article>

items.title: Judge Once Again Blocks Trump Administration’s Plans to Restrict Mail-In Ballots
items.author: Zach Montague
items.content: <article>The ruling arrived before the Supreme Court could decide whether to intervene but appeared certain to set off yet another round of appeals.</article>

items.title: Trump Says He Will Spend Some of His War Chest on Republicans
items.author: Luke Broadwater
items.content: <article>President Trump said he intends to hold some money back, even as Republican candidates ask for financial support.</article>

items.title: Postal Service Internal Watchdog Opens Inquiry After Whistle-Blower’s Complaint
items.author: Eileen Sullivan
items.content: <article>The Trump administration’s effort to screen mail-in ballots for the midterms is facing numerous challenges.</article>

items.title: North Carolina Adds New Restrictions to Vote-by-Mail Program
items.author: Emily Davies
items.content: <article>The changes are almost certain to cause some votes to be tossed. They come at a time when President Trump is promoting false claims of widespread fraud in mail voting.</article>

items.title: Trump’s Latest Clemency Grants Benefit Drug Offenders, Union Boss
items.author: Kenneth P. Vogel
items.content: <article>The president issued pardons or commutations to 30 people on Thursday, continuing his unorthodox and unpredictable use of clemency power.</article>

items.title: The Tetris Company Denounces Trump White House Clone of Tetris
items.author: Chris Cameron
items.content: <article>Responding to Build the Wall, an apparent copy of the retro video game, the Tetris Company said “we take copyright infringement very seriously.”</article>

items.title: C.D.C. Says No Deaths This Year Attributed to Measles
items.author: Apoorva Mandavilli
items.content: <article>The agency’s weekly update escalates a political fight after Pennsylvania said two deaths had been caused by the virus.</article>

items.title: Ambassador Who Removed Kehinde Wiley Work Described It as a Lesbian Picnic
items.author: Zachary Small
items.content: <article>Trump officials recently removed a painting from the U.S. Embassy in the Dominican Republic without explaining why. An interview by Ambassador Leah Campos shed some light.</article>

items.title: What to Know About Trump’s Efforts to Block Mail-in Ballots
items.author: Reid J. Epstein
items.content: <article>We sort through the proposed changes and court challenges, less than two months from Election Day.</article>
